summary: Operator tooling and documentation, no router or agent code change (ADR-0066). Defect: deploy.py agent_signing_key created a new Ed25519 signing key whenever agent-update.key was missing, so a lost key silently became a new one, releases were signed with it and every node refused them; the file was also written before its mode was tightened. Now deploy/agent_keys.py has signing_key_state (present with public key, or missing with both ways), create_agent_key (first key, refuses if a signing or prepared key exists; O_EXCL 0600), and replace_lost_agent_key(reason) (refuses without a reason of at least 8 characters, while the key exists, or while a prepared next key exists; writes the new key 0600 and agent-update.recovery-<time>.txt with time, reason and public key only; prints the node step). deploy.py main refuses --agent without a key before connect(), offers --create-agent-key and --replace-lost-agent-key, and agent_signing_key only loads. New agent/Set-UpdateKey.ps1 and Set-UpdateKey.cmd (execution-policy wrapper): node-local Add, Complete, Replace and Check of update.public_key/public_keys, with administrator, service, agent >= 0.29.0 and key-format checks before acting (format checked by pattern before decoding), backup, check-config with the installed binary, service restart and rollback; .NET file I/O for Windows PowerShell 5.1. README (EN/DE): rotation and recovery steps, and comparing the UI fingerprint with skirnir-agent identity before approving a node (TM-07).

findings.evidence: A missing agent-update.key was silently replaced by a new key in deploy.py --agent; lost-key recovery was undefined.
findings.resolution: Explicit first-key and recorded lost-key steps; --agent refuses without a key; node script in the repository. Recovery is not yet practised in the deployment.

findings.evidence: Fingerprint verification before approval was asked for but not described.
findings.resolution: README procedure with skirnir-agent identity; plausibility checks of approved agents remain.

tests.evidence: 0 failure(s); 27 PASS on Linux including owner-only modes of first, next and replacement keys.

tests.command: agent/Set-UpdateKey.ps1 under Windows PowerShell 5.1 with the agent 0.29.1 binary and check-config (admin and service checks replaced in a test copy)
tests.evidence: Check, Add, repeated Add (current), Complete, Complete without Add refused, Replace (also with another key listed), invalid key refused; no BOM, CRLF kept.

tests.evidence: No failures; ADR index ok: 66 ADRs; ALLE OK; control flow ok; All checks passed.
